info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Action Management API
info.description: The Corporate Action Management API streamlines the processes surrounding corporate actions in banking operations, such as stock splits, dividends, and mergers. This API enables users to update the details of specific corporate actions using relevant identifiers. Designed for financial institutions and investment firms, it provides a seamless method for ensuring accurate and timely updates to corporate action events. With this API, businesses can maintain compliance and improve operational efficiency in handling market changes.
